Class ExecutionContract

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.plugin.execution.ExecutionContract
public class ExecutionContract extends Object
Execution Contract - Language-neutral contract between Engine and Executor This is THE critical artifact that enables: - Replay - Audit - Retry - Time-travel - Multi-language executors
